cases.title: Record visited link to Global History
cases.description: Verify that a visited link is successfully recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Verify correct link is recorded after server redirect
cases.description: Verify that after a server redirect occurs when visiting a link, the correct redirected link is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Launch history link in browser window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Delete a History entry
cases.description: Verify that a selected History entry is successfully deleted from the history list.

cases.title: Delete multiple history entries
cases.description: Verify that multiple history entries can be selected and deleted so that they are no longer displayed in the history list.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Verify that the Global History is completely cleared.

cases.title: Group history items by Day, Site, and None
cases.description: Verify that history items can be successfully grouped by Day, by Site, and with None selected.

cases.title: Verify history sorting and reverse-sorting
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be sorted and reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize history columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be resized to show or hide more of the entries.

cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be successfully shown and hidden according to the requirement.

cases.title: Re-visit recently visited sites via Back and Forward button dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be re-visited by selecting them from the Back and Forward button dropdown menus.

cases.title: Create a new empty session history file for a new browser window or restart
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created when opening a new browser window or performing a restart.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases effectively cover the requirements without any blockers, speculative cases, or missing scenario types.
All requirements have corresponding test cases, and the test suite covers all necessary scenarios without any blocking issues.
